zh-CN.name: video-use 视频剪辑
zh-CN.shortDesc: 上游工作流会在初始盘点、提出剪辑策略前将素材音频上传至 ElevenLabs Scribe；上游不设同意确认，须事先授权。需 API 密钥且可能另收费；需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg/ffprobe。

en-US.name: video-use
en-US.shortDesc: During initial inventory, the upstream workflow uploads source audio to ElevenLabs Scribe before presenting an edit strategy. It has no consent gate; authorize the transfer in advance. An API key is required and separate charges may apply. Requires Python 3.10+ and ffmpeg/ffprobe.
